coverage: Selected official mission milestones and two historical MEDA summaries. This is a sparse curated catalog, not a complete observation archive. Unknown publication dates are excluded from Known by Date. Landing sites are not time-varying rover positions.

records.title: Mariner 4 flies by Mars
records.description: A flyby returned close views of the Martian surface. Closest approach is July 15 UTC, commonly commemorated as July 14 in US local time.
records.uncertainty: Curated historical record. The original publication date is unknown unless shown; a modern mission summary does not establish what was public on the event date.

records.title: MEDA temperature extrema, sols 43–44
records.description: Published temperature extrema across two sols in the Jezero landing area.
records.uncertainty: Acquisition window: April 3–4, 2021, sols 43–44. Combined extrema; not separate daily weather measurements. Precise rover coordinate not given in this report. No wind or current-weather time series is included.
